title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Ragona separates serial position, card rank and suit through role-bound mnemonic carriers
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. An actual 1434 worked card account uses outer locus for serial position, person for suit, held locus-object for numerical rank and crown/horse/kneeling for court rank. Four OR six apples both encode seven clubs because apples occupy seventh catalogue position; one OR two fish encode five cups. Arbitrary actions are expressly permitted but typed carriers are not interchangeable. No Voynich numerals or meanings assigned.

source.owner: Venice, Biblioteca Nazionale Marciana, Lat.VI.274 (=2885), ff15v–34r
source.exact_sections: ff23r–24v cards; f24v numerical rule; f17r ff household loci.
source.text_layer: Cacopardo 2021 thesis printed pp170–171 notes427–430; ownership n396. Historical Latin quoted by scholar; no direct manuscript collation by producer.
source.corpus_limit: Complete quoted card-example passage retained by exact locator. Independent full100-locus catalogue not transcribed here; named index relations below are author statements within the example.

complete_example_units.scene: Rich man at paternoster locus, holding a cap
complete_example_units.author_commitment: Cap is eighth locus-object; first outside locus fixes first card. Urinating in cap, tearing it or another action permitted.

complete_example_units.scene: Same rich man at cabbages locus, with gold crown
complete_example_units.author_commitment: Second locus fixes position; crown king rank.

complete_example_units.scene: Same rich man at cheese locus, on horse
complete_example_units.author_commitment: Third locus fixes position; horse knight rank.

complete_example_units.scene: Same rich man at fourth locus, kneeling
complete_example_units.author_commitment: Kneeling is rank cue; Latin el picol / pedestrem retained rather than assuming pictorial age.

complete_example_units.scene: Club bearer with four OR six apples hanging on club
complete_example_units.author_commitment: Apples are seventh locus-object; multiplicity four/six not rank.

complete_example_units.scene: Drunkard with one OR two fish on wine cup
complete_example_units.author_commitment: Five cups is encoded using one OR two fish. Fish-as-fifth-locus is inferred from this paired example and the general index rule; unlike apple=seventh and cheese=third, this quoted passage does not explicitly state the ordinal in a separate explanatory clause.
Cheese third locus-object, sword-person suit. Quoted transition does not clearly introduce new swordsman or outer position; do not repair.

finite_alternatives.literal_scene: Object types and counts describe the remembered event itself; four apples versus six apples changes that event.
finite_alternatives.global_object_number: An object has one numerical denotation regardless of its relation or location.
finite_alternatives.role_bound_mnemonic_tuple: External locus denotes serial address; attached locus-object denotes rank; selected person denotes suit; action variations can be mnemonic intensifiers rather than payload.

unequal_consequences: The author explicitly preserves seven clubs across four/six apples and five cups across one/two fish. Literal cardinal matching predicts different ranks and fails this source.
Cheese is the OUTER location for third card knight coins, but an ATTACHED object for rank three swords. A reading conflating the two roles loses either serial position or card value.
Same rich person occurs in four different ordered loci with changed attributes; those records share suit but differ in rank and sequence. A global person=entire-card identity fails.
Court ranks use attribute substitutions rather than arithmetic locus indices; not every object is a uniform numeral.
design.not_illustrator_inference: These are instructions and explanations in authorial Latin as transcribed in the thesis, not deductions from an illustration. Cosimo is an optional familiar wealthy exemplar; not a fixed personal-name lexicon. Choice of gambling/counting application and intended merchant audience are scholarly interpretations, not necessary encoding commitments.
design.construction_constraint: Any whole account adopting this production model must bind serial, category and value separately over all entries. Changing outer place alone changes address; changing held index carrier changes rank; optional action changes need not change payload. Distinct lexical constructions might encode these relations, but none is nominated in Voynich.
unknowns: Full locus catalogue and exact manuscript variants require collation.
Seven-example excerpt has an unresolved transition before swords.
No independent target role binding or candidate complete account is supplied.
Context-free object substitution could memorize these scenes; the repeated binding law across additional complete entries is the distinguishing requirement.
The method encodes structured tuples, not arbitrary proposition syntax or fluent narrative translation.

predecessors.retained: Ratio-only scaling contrast invalid; current contrast changes pictured number while explicitly retaining encoded value, not amount ratios.
Historical count-bearing names/class counts differ from a stable predefined object-index relation applied across cards.
Scoped mirror meanings depend on virtue/science registers; here the same catalogue object has serial-place or rank-carrier role within one account.
Recursive prefix tree is textual compression; this is relational scene encoding. Neither implies the other.
Old fixed-root coordinate/instruction/catalogue exploratory dispatch supplies no independent word bindings or evidence for Ragona. No old German meanings imported.

appended_qualifications.issue: The GLOBAL_OBJECT_NUMBER rival was not distinguished from role-bound mnemonic tuples by the cheese example.
appended_qualifications.source_case: Cheese retains ordinal THREE both when used as outer third serial location and when attached to encode rank three. No object-denotation or namespace change occurs.
appended_qualifications.surviving_rival: A fixed object-to-index dictionary plus ordinary role-sensitive binding reproduces these observations. It is a surviving rival or the same architecture described at a different level, not an excluded model.
actual_unequal_consequences: The explicit four-OR-six apples variants both encode rank seven; interpreting depicted cardinality directly as rank gives four or six instead.
The first cap scene permits alternative actions while preserving first-position eight-coins payload; treating the entire detailed action narrative as payload would distinguish the alternatives.
boundaries: The rich person consistently represents coins; crown, horse and kneeling distinguish court ranks. This does not demonstrate context-dependent suit identity.
Different syntactic roles distinguish serial index from rank, but role binding is not itself a change of lexical object value.
No claim that actions are always arbitrary: court-rank kneeling is a committed attribute, while the author expressly permits alternatives for the first cap action.
No Voynich namespace, numeral, word meaning, correspondence or experiment follows.
